title: 70 miles an hour / He can't have been ...
subtitle: 每小时70英里 / 他不可能是……

lead.question: 开车被警察拦下时，警察会怎么质问你、你怎么辩解？中文里「他刚才一定开到 70 迈了」「我不可能开那么快」——英语怎么把这种「对过去的猜测」说出来？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象一条限速路上的场景：丈夫开快车，警察挥手拦停，妻子在旁边数落「我早叫你开慢点」。这里的关键句型有两个：① You must have been driving ... — must have been（doing）表示对过去正在发生的事的肯定推测；② I can't have been. — can't have been 表示对过去的否定推测（注意不是 mustn't have been！）。先试着用英语说「他刚才准是在睡觉」，再听警察和 Harry 的这场公路对话。
goals: 能用 must have been (doing) 对过去做肯定推测
能用 can't have been (doing) 对过去做否定推测，且知道不能用 mustn't have been
掌握本课词汇：wave, track, mile, overtake, speed limit, dream, sign, driving licence, charge, darling
理解插入语 Where do you think you are? 与 That's why ... 结构
会用 had better (not) 提出劝告，会说 take one's advice
lead.summary: 第 129 课 Ann 提醒丈夫 Harry：警察正向你挥手，要你停车。警察质问「你以为你在哪儿？赛车道上吗？你刚才准是以每小时 70 英里的速度开车」，Harry 辩解 I can't have been；警察说自己超车时正开 80 英里，又问「难道没看见限速牌」，Harry 说自己准是走神了，Ann 证明「我刚才正叫他开慢点」。警察这次不罚款，警告下不为例；Ann 最后补刀：下次你最好听我的劝告。第 130 课用 He can't have been ... He must have been ... 集中操练对过去的肯定与否定推测。
lead.tips: ① must have been（doing）对过去做肯定推测：You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.；② 否定推测用 can't have been，不用 mustn't have been：I can't have been.；③ 接进行式表示「当时一定正在做某事」：He must have been sleeping.；④ do you think 是插入语，插入后主语 you are 不再倒装；⑤ That's why I didn't see the sign. 是 why 引导的表语从句，解释原因；⑥ you'd better not do it again：had better 后接动词原形，否定是 had better not；⑦ take one's advice 听从某人的劝告；⑧ speed limit 限速，driving licence 驾照，charge 罚款/收费。

questions.q: What does Ann advise her husband to do next time?
questions.zh: 安建议她的丈夫下次做什么？
questions.a: He'd better take her advice (to drive slowly) next time.
questions.aZh: 下次他最好听她的劝告（开慢点）。
questions.hint: 听课文最后一句 Well, next time you'd better ...。

questions.q: How fast does the policeman think Harry was driving?
questions.zh: 警察认为 Harry 刚才开得有多快？
questions.a: He thinks Harry must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
questions.aZh: 警察认为他刚才准是以每小时 70 英里的速度开车。
questions.hint: 听 You must have been driving at ... miles an hour.

questions.q: How fast was the policeman driving when he overtook Harry?
questions.zh: 警察追上 Harry 时自己开得有多快？
questions.a: He was doing eighty (miles an hour).
questions.aZh: 他正以每小时 80 英里的速度开车。
questions.hint: I was doing eighty when I overtook you.

questions.q: Will the policeman charge Harry this time?
questions.zh: 这次警察会罚 Harry 的款吗？
questions.a: No, he won't. But he'd better not do it again.
questions.aZh: 这次不会，但 Harry 最好别再这样做了。
questions.hint: 听 I won't charge you this time. But ...。

questions.q: Why does Harry say 'I must have been dreaming' instead of 'I must dream'?
questions.zh: Harry 为什么说 I must have been dreaming 而不说 I must dream？
questions.a: Because he is guessing about the past: he didn't see the sign a moment ago, so he must have been dreaming (at that time). 'must dream' would only mean a present or future guess.
questions.aZh: 因为他在推测过去：刚才没看见牌子，所以说「当时准是走神了」。must dream 只能表示对现在或将来的推测。
questions.hint: 对过去的猜测要用 must have been (doing)。

questions.q: They can't have been Canadian. They must have been Australian. / She can't have been a dentist. She must have been a doctor.
questions.zh: 第 130 课操练：用 can't have been（否定推测）+ must have been（肯定推测）对过去下判断。
questions.a: It can't have been cheap. It must have been expensive. / They can't have been sitting. They must have been standing.
questions.aZh: 那东西当时不可能便宜，一定很贵。/ 他们当时不可能坐着，一定是站着的。
questions.hint: 否定推测用 can't have been，千万别说 mustn't have been。

lines.speaker: ANN
lines.en: Look, Harry! That policeman's waving to you. He wants you to stop.
lines.zh: 瞧，哈里！那个警察正朝你挥手呢。他要你停下来。
lines.note: 人物名原教材多作 Gary（加里），源文本作 Harry；wave to sb 向某人招手

lines.speaker: POLICEMAN
lines.en: Where do you think you are? On a race track? You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
lines.zh: 你认为你现在是在哪儿？在赛车道上吗？你刚才一定是以每小时 70 英里的速度开车。
lines.note: do you think 是插入语；must have been doing 对过去进行的事做肯定推测

lines.speaker: HARRY
lines.note: = I can't have been driving at seventy miles an hour. 否定推测用 can't have been

lines.speaker: POLICEMAN
lines.en: I was doing eighty when I overtook you.
lines.zh: 我是以每小时 80 英里的速度赶上你的。
lines.note: do eighty 口语指「时速 80 英里」；overtook 是 overtake 的过去式

lines.speaker: POLICEMAN
lines.en: Didn't you see the speed limit?
lines.zh: 难道你没看见限速牌吗？
lines.note: 否定疑问句，带责备语气

lines.speaker: HARRY
lines.en: I'm afraid I didn't, officer. I must have been dreaming.
lines.zh: 恐怕我没有看见，警官。我一定是思想开小差了。
lines.note: must have been doing 表示「当时准是在……」

lines.speaker: ANN
lines.en: He wasn't dreaming, officer. I was telling him to drive slowly.
lines.zh: 警官，他思想没有开小差。我刚才正告诉他开慢点。
lines.note: 过去进行时 was telling 强调当时一直在说

lines.speaker: HARRY
lines.en: That's why I didn't see the sign.
lines.zh: 所以我才没看见那牌子。
lines.note: That's why + 从句，解释原因

lines.speaker: POLICEMAN
lines.en: Let me see your driving-licence and your insurance certificate.
lines.zh: 让我看一看你的驾驶执照和保险证明。

lines.speaker: POLICEMAN
lines.en: I won't charge you this time. But you'd better not do it again!
lines.zh: 这次我就不罚你款了。但你最好不要再这样做了！
lines.note: charge 罚款；had better not + 动词原形

lines.speaker: HARRY
lines.en: Thank you. I'll certainly be more careful.
lines.zh: 谢谢您。我以后一定会多加注意。

lines.speaker: ANN
lines.en: I told you to drive slowly, Harry.
lines.zh: 加里，我刚才叫你开慢点吧。
lines.note: tell sb to do sth 叫某人做某事

lines.speaker: HARRY
lines.en: You always tell me to drive slowly, darling.
lines.zh: 你总是叫我开慢点，亲爱的。
lines.note: always + 一般现在时，表习惯性抱怨

lines.speaker: ANN
lines.en: Well, next time you'd better take my advice!
lines.zh: 好啦，下次你最好还是听从我的劝告！
lines.note: take one's advice 听从劝告

text.title: He can't have been ... / He must have been ...

drill.q: ___ can't have been ___. ___ must have been ___.
drill.zh: ……当时不可能是……，一定是……。（用 can't have been 表否定推测、must have been 表肯定推测，操练对过去的判断）

slots.zh: 他们 — 加拿大人 — 澳大利亚人
她 — 芬兰人 — 俄罗斯人
他们 — 日本人 — 中国人
他们 — 屠夫 — 面包师

slots.en: He — a sales rep — the boss
slots.zh: 他 — 推销员 — 老板

slots.en: They — listening to the radio — watching television
slots.zh: 他们 — 听收音机 — 看电视
他们 — 坐着 — 站着

answers: I don't think they were. They can't have been Canadian. They must have been Australian.
I don't think she was. She can't have been a dentist. She must have been a doctor.
I don't think it was. It can't have been cheap. It must have been expensive.
I don't think they were. They can't have been sitting. They must have been standing.

exercises.q: 填空：He didn't come to work yesterday. He ___ have been ill.
exercises.note: 没来上班→推测「当时准是病了」，用 must have been。

exercises.q: 用 must (be sleep) 完成句子：She didn't hear the phone.
exercises.note: 对过去正在进行的动作做推测：must have been doing。

exercises.q: 第 130 课：他们认为他们不可能是加拿大人，一定是澳大利亚人。（英译）
exercises.a: They can't have been Canadian. They must have been Australian.
exercises.note: 否定推测用 can't have been，肯定推测用 must have been。

exercises.q: 改错：He mustn't have been sleeping.
exercises.note: 对过去的否定推测不用 mustn't have been，要用 can't have been。

exercises.q: 汉译英：你最好不要再这样做了。
exercises.a: You'd better not do it again.
exercises.note: had better 后接动词原形，否定形式是 had better not。

exercises.q: 汉译英：下次你最好还是听从我的劝告！
exercises.a: Next time you'd better take my advice!
exercises.note: take one's advice 听从某人的劝告；advice 不可数。

exercises.q: 填空：I was doing eighty when I ___ you. (超车，用 overtake 的过去式)
exercises.note: overtake 的过去式是 overtook，过去分词 overtaken。

quiz.q: You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour. 表达的意思是：
quiz.zh: 这句话表示对什么的推测？
options: 对过去正在进行的动作的肯定推测
对现在状态的肯定推测
quiz.note: must have been doing 表示「当时一定正在……」，是对过去的推测。

quiz.q: 对过去做否定推测（「当时不可能……」）应该用：
quiz.note: 否定推测只能用 can't have been；英语不说 mustn't have been。

quiz.q: That policeman's waving to you. 中 wave 的意思是：
quiz.note: wave 作动词是「招手、挥手示意」，wave to sb 向某人招手。

quiz.q: You'd better not do it again. 说明 had better 的否定形式是：
options: had better not + 动词原形
had not better + 动词原形
quiz.note: not 直接放在 had better 之后、动词原形之前。

quiz.q: I was doing eighty when I overtook you. 中 overtook 是：
Take my advice! 的意思是：
quiz.note: take one's advice 是固定搭配「听从某人的劝告」。

grammar.title: 表示猜测和推断的情态助动词 must 和 can't（2）：对过去的推测
grammar.structure: must have been / must have been doing（肯定推测）；can't have been / can't have been doing（否定推测）
grammar.definition: must 与 can't 不仅能对现在和将来做猜测，还能对过去做推断：用 must have been 表示「当时一定……」，用 can't have been（而不是 mustn't have been）表示「当时不可能……」；后接进行式则表示对过去正在进行的动作的猜测。
grammar.usage: You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour. / I can't have been. / She must have been 36.

examples.en: I didn't see it. I must have been dreaming.
examples.zh: 我没看见。我当时一定是在胡思乱想吧。

examples.en: He can't have been reading. He must have been sleeping.
examples.zh: 他那时肯定不是在看书，他准是在睡觉。

examples.en: She can't have been 29. She must have been 36.
examples.zh: 她那时肯定不会是 29 岁，她一定 36 岁了。

grammar.title: 插入语 do you think
grammar.structure: 疑问词 + do you think + 陈述语序（主语 + 谓语）
grammar.definition: do you think 用在特殊疑问句中作插入语，用来征询见解或表达看法。因为插入语本身已是疑问式（主谓倒装），所以 you are 等部分不能再对调。类似的插入语还有 I hope, I think, I'm afraid, you know 等，可位于句中或句尾。
grammar.usage: 警察质问时的语气表达：Where do you think you are?

examples.en: Where do you think you are? On a race track?
examples.zh: 你认为你现在是在哪儿？在赛车道上吗？

examples.en: What do you think he wants?
examples.zh: 你认为他想要什么？

grammar.title: That's why ... 与 had better (not)
grammar.structure: That's why + 从句（表语从句）；had better (not) + 动词原形
grammar.definition: why I didn't see the sign 作 is 的表语从句，用来说明事情的原因。had better 表示「最好（做某事）」，提出劝告或警告，后接动词原形，否定形式为 had better not do，如 you'd better take my advice / you'd better not do it again。
grammar.usage: That's why I didn't see the sign. / You'd better not do it again!

examples.en: That's why I didn't see the sign.
examples.zh: 所以我才没看见那牌子。

examples.en: Next time you'd better take my advice!
examples.zh: 下次你最好还是听从我的劝告！

examples.en: Didn't you see the speed limit?
examples.zh: 难道你没看见限速牌吗？

phrases.usage: 驾驶执照（美语作 driver's license）

examples.en: Let me see your driving-licence and your insurance certificate.
examples.zh: 让我看一看你的驾驶执照和保险证明。

examples.en: That policeman's waving to you.
examples.zh: 那个警察正朝你挥手呢。

examples.en: Well, next time you'd better take my advice!
examples.zh: 好啦，下次你最好还是听从我的劝告！

phrases.usage: 最好别做……（提出劝告或警告）

examples.en: But you'd better not do it again!
examples.zh: 但你最好不要再这样做了！

phrases.phrase: do eighty / seventy miles an hour
phrases.usage: 口语：以……时速开车（do + 数字表速度）

examples.en: I was doing eighty when I overtook you.
examples.zh: 我是以每小时 80 英里的速度赶上你的。
